name: KositBablo10-1
summary: This EA trades EURUSD using RSI and MA indicators across D1 and H1 timeframes to generate buy and sell pending stop orders. It places BuyStop/SellStop orders with a reversal (turnover) pending order in version 10-1, and uses a money management system that scales lot size based on free margin. The strategy is a multi-timeframe momentum entry system with fixed TP/SL and conditional pending order placement.
summary_zh: 该EA基于D1和H1双周期的RSI与MA指标在EURUSD上生成买入和卖出挂单信号。10-1版本在主单之外还放置反向挂单作为对冲，仓位根据可用保证金动态调整。策略属于多周期动量入场系统，采用固定止盈止损和条件挂单方式。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是多周期RSI与MA组合信号驱动挂单交易。买入条件为：D1 RSI(15)<60 且 H1 RSI(5)<48 且 H1 MA(20)>MA(2)，满足后放置BuyStop挂单和反向SellStop挂单。卖出条件为：H1 RSI(15)>55 且 H1 MA(23)>MA(2)，满足后放置SellStop挂单（循环3次下单）和反向BuyStop挂单。仓位管理基于账户可用保证金除以6500（10-1版）或2000（10版）来计算手数，上限15手，下限0.1手。出场依靠固定TP=1400点和SL=500点，反向单的止盈止损有所缩减。TURBO模式可跳过挂单检查直接开仓，属于高风险加速模式。整体策略缺乏新K线检查、点差过滤、滑点保护等基本风控机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is a multi-timeframe RSI and MA combined signal system driving pending stop orders. Buy condition: D1 RSI(15) below 60 AND H1 RSI(5) below 48 AND H1 MA(20) above MA(2), triggering a BuyStop order plus a reverse SellStop order. Sell condition: H1 RSI(15) above 55 AND H1 MA(23) above MA(2), triggering SellStop orders (looped 3 times) plus a reverse BuyStop order. Position sizing divides free margin by 6500 (v10-1) or 2000 (v10), clamped between 0.1 and 15 lots. Exits rely on fixed TP=1400 pips and SL=500 pips, with reduced TP/SL on reversal orders. The TURBO mode bypasses pending order checks to force new positions, which is a high-risk acceleration feature. The strategy critically lacks new bar checks, spread filters, slippage protection, and magic number assignment for order tracking.

parameters.name: TURBO
parameters.description: 加速模式开关，0为正常模式，大于0时跳过挂单检查
parameters.description_en: Turbo mode switch: 0=normal, >0 skips pending order check

pros: 多周期RSI+MA组合信号提供较好的趋势确认框架
反向挂单机制提供了部分对冲保护，主单止损后反向单仍可能获利
仓位根据可用保证金动态调整，避免过度杠杆
pros_en: Multi-timeframe RSI+MA combination provides a reasonable trend confirmation framework
Reverse pending order mechanism offers partial hedging protection - if the main order stops out, the reversal order may still profit
Dynamic lot sizing based on free margin prevents excessive leverage
cons: 缺少Magic Number分配，无法区分本EA与其他EA的订单
无新K线检查，每个tick都会重复执行逻辑，可能频繁挂单
SellStop循环3次下单逻辑不合理，使用相同价格重复发送3次相同挂单
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下挂单容易无效
TP=1400/SL=500的盈亏比虽然可观但止损金额过大
TURBO模式跳过挂单检查极其危险
cons_en: No magic number assigned - cannot distinguish this EA's orders from others on the same account
No new bar check - logic executes on every tick, potentially flooding with duplicate pending orders
The 3-iteration SellStop loop is illogical - sends identical pending orders at the same price 3 times
No spread filter - pending orders may be invalid or too costly under high spread conditions
TP=1400/SL=500 ratio is favorable but the absolute SL size (500 pips) risks large drawdowns
TURBO mode bypassing order checks is extremely dangerous and can lead to uncontrolled position accumulation
improvements: 添加Magic Number用于订单标识和跟踪管理
添加新K线检查机制避免每个tick重复执行挂单逻辑
修复SellStop循环3次下单的bug，应该改为在不同价位分批挂单或删除循环
增加点差过滤和滑点保护机制
为所有挂单添加过期时间设置
improvements_en: Add magic number for order identification and management tracking
Add new bar check to prevent executing pending order logic on every tick
Fix the SellStop 3-iteration loop bug - either place orders at different price levels or remove the loop entirely
Add spread filter and slippage protection mechanisms
Set expiration time for all pending orders to avoid stale orders

risk_points: 无新K线检查导致每个tick可能重复挂单，造成订单堆积
SellStop循环3次在同一价位发送3个相同挂单是严重bug
TURBO模式跳过挂单检查可导致无限开仓
无Magic Number无法管理本EA的订单
SL=500点绝对值过大，单笔亏损可能极大
risk_points_en: No new bar check allows duplicate pending orders on every tick, causing order accumulation
SellStop 3-iteration loop sending 3 identical orders at the same price is a severe bug
TURBO mode bypassing order checks can lead to unlimited position opening
No magic number makes it impossible to manage this EA's orders properly
SL=500 pips absolute value is excessively large, single trade loss can be devastating
